title: Motion design showreel
summary: An abstract motion-design reel in a brand palette: dot grids, spring shape morphs, iris, stripe and shutter transitions, masked and circular kinetic type for three words, and a name lockup with an impact.
gallery_share: 'Make a 15 s showreel that shows what an incredible motion designer you are' is one of the most common prompts in public model-made video galleries.
limits: Abstract reel: it does not show anyone's real client work
Fixed six-beat structure; beats scale with duration and read best from 12 to 18 s
Latin scripts set best; one typeface (Inter or the system sans)
